Conditions raised by zuproto

Source: R/conditions.R
zuproto-conditions.Rd

Every error zuproto raises carries a condition class, so it can be caught by kind rather than by matching the message, which may change. Every class below inherits from zuproto_error.

Details

zuproto_invalid_argument

An argument was unusable, such as a pool that is not one, or a type name that is not a single string. Carries arg, the argument at fault.

zuproto_io_error

A file could not be opened or read, or a connection could not be read from.

zuproto_pool_error

A descriptor set could not be added to a pool: the bytes are not a FileDescriptorSet, a file imports one that is neither in the set nor in the pool, or upb rejected a file. Carries file, the file at fault, when there is one.

zuproto_pool_conflict

A subclass of zuproto_pool_error: a file of the same name is already in the pool, or earlier in the set, with different contents. Carries file.

zuproto_unknown_type

A message type is not in the pool. Carries type.

zuproto_parse_error

The input is not a valid message of the type: it ends early, has a bad tag, a length beyond the input, or the wrong wire type. Carries status.

zuproto_invalid_utf8

A subclass of zuproto_parse_error: a string field is not valid UTF-8, in proto2 as in proto3.

zuproto_unrepresentable

The input is valid but holds a value R cannot: a string containing a NUL byte, or longer than an R string may be. Carries field, the field's full name.

zuproto_type_mismatch

proto_encode() was given a value of the wrong form for its field: the wrong R type, a number out of range or not whole, a name that is not a value of the enum, NA inside a repeated field, a second member of a oneof, or a map key given twice. Carries path, the field at fault, such as "points[2].x".

zuproto_unknown_field

proto_encode() was given a name the message type does not define. Carries path.

zuproto_missing_required

proto_encode() with check_required = TRUE: a proto2 required field is not set.

zuproto_limit_error

A limit was reached. The subclasses zuproto_size_limit (the input, or the memory decoding it needs, is too large for max_size) and zuproto_depth_limit (messages nest deeper than max_depth) name which. Carries limit, the argument's name, and limit_value.

Warnings inherit zuproto_warning:

zuproto_precision_loss

Values could not be represented exactly: 64-bit integers beyond 2^53 decoded as doubles, or a 32-bit -2^31, which R reserves for NA. Carries n, how many.

zuproto_unknown_enum

Enum numbers the enum does not define became NA. Carries n.

Examples

pool <- proto_pool()
tryCatch(
  proto_fields(pool, "no.such.Message"),
  zuproto_unknown_type = function(e) e$type
)
#> [1] "no.such.Message"
